notes.title: Make War is leaving early access!
notes.content:
Happy news! Make War is leaving early access!

Game receives a huge update:
1. New location in the style of cyberpunk.
2. Steam Achievements
3. Updated menu
4. Updated world map
5. Added many new sounds
6. Improved balance
7. Each part of the portal can now be dragged separately
8. Improved some UI elements
9. Added traces of explosions and holes from worms

We continue to work on the game and are always happy to read your comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35526577/a875408e7ca25f88762101c74dd449af56f2d71d.png[/img]
